payload.title: 结构 gate 实验：真实 latent 管线 A/B/AB 调制 + 证伪 + 部署锚点

payload.setup: PatchTSTEncoder -> z=[x;h](d=10), z'=Az+Bu, decoder=first2; new context encoder over [x_history;u_history] -> c(16); low-rank modulation r=3; all modes identical training; seeds 0/1
payload.result: A-only dominates (H20 -73.7%/-74.3%); B-only ~fixed (or worse at H>=10); AB ~= A-only; deployed EDMD P=4 anchor H20 0.1588 matches fixed baseline
payload.interpretation: In the true latent pipeline the history-dependent modulation belongs on the state-transition A(c), reversing the round-11 observation-space proxy conclusion (which could not express A-modulation).
